Class DatastoreFunction

java.lang.Object
org.apache.openjpa.jdbc.kernel.exps.DatastoreFunction
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Val, Value
public class DatastoreFunction extends Object
A unary operator that executes a datastore specific function with zero or more arguments.
Author:
Pinaki Poddar

    getLoadTypeCode()
    Return the type code to load the value of this expression with: JavaSQLTypes.SQL_DATE for a Date, JavaSQLTypes.TIME for a Time, JavaSQLTypes.TIMESTAMP for a Timestamp and JavaTypes.DATE for a Date, which is loaded like a Date field, as a driver can return another type for the column, such as the Timestamp the Oracle driver returns for a DATE column or the LocalDateTime MySQL Connector/J returns for a DATETIME column; else JavaSQLTypes.JDBC_DEFAULT.
